$comment: Requirement IDs: RES-02, RES-03, RES-07, XCUT-08 | New contract owned by M01 | Shape frozen in design_documents/design_plans/DP-A-resilience-layer.md §4.2 | Validated via RES-04; malformed config falls back to checked-in defaults (RES-AC-04, GOV-RES-02). Secondary-provider callable is supplied out-of-band to the wrapper, never serialized.
title: ResilienceConfig

timeout_ms.description: per-call timeout applied to primary, secondary, and repair calls; timed-out attempt triggers retry if retries remain. Upper bound raised from the DP-A-era 120000 so agentic transports (PGM sweep chat turns) fit their minute-scale budgets.

retries.description: additional attempts beyond the initial call; 0 disables retry

factor.description: multiplier applied per retry; used by exponential policy

max_ms.description: upper cap on any single computed backoff delay

jitter.description: ±25% uniform jitter added to computed delays

order.description: single source of ordering — array position is the only priority; disabled steps are skipped silently

enabled.description: disabled by default to avoid surprise provider billing; callable itself passed out-of-band
pre-recorded replay step; replay subspace replay::<key> of the same RES-05 store
terminal step emitting DegradedResult — always enabled, chain never ends without a typed degraded signal

cache_key_strategy.description: auto = sha256(provider|model|input_hash); explicit = caller-supplied cache_key_explicit, hashed once for filename uniformity

cache_key_explicit.description: caller-supplied deterministic key (kebab-case, e.g. demo-step-acme-widget-overview); required iff cache_key_strategy == explicit

forced_degraded.description: kill switch (RES-07): when true, primary + secondary are skipped and the wrapper enters fallback directly for rehearsal / live-demo degradation
